# IJELS - International Journal of English Literature and Social Sciences

> > A peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal publishing research in English literature and social sciences with international indexing and scholarly impact.

IJELS (ISSN 2456-7620) is an open-access, peer-reviewed journal dedicated to advancing scholarship in English literature and social sciences. The journal is indexed across major academic databases including CrossRef, Index Copernicus, WorldCat, and Scilit, serving researchers and academics globally.
